admin.host_help: Address of your Sonic server, as seen from this forum's server (for example 127.0.0.1, or the container name).
admin.bucket_help: Optional. Keeps this forum's index apart when several forums share one Sonic. Leave blank to use your forum's host name. Rebuild the index after changing it.
admin.password_help: Sonic's channel.auth_password. Stored on the server and never sent back to the browser.
admin.password_saved: A password is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
admin.drivers_help: Text searches go to Sonic; browsing and filters keep using the database. Flarum still decides who may see each result. If Sonic is unreachable, searches fall back to the database.

error.not_configured: Enter a host and save first.
error.unreachable: Could not reach Sonic at that host and port.
error.timeout: Sonic did not answer in time.
error.protocol: Something answered, but it does not speak the Sonic protocol.

admin.rebuild_help: Rebuild every Sonic index from your existing content. Run it once after connecting, and whenever results look out of date (for example after Sonic was offline). On large forums, run a queue worker so it happens in the background.
admin.rebuild_failed: Could not rebuild the index. Check the connection.
